VendorID: TPEP provider: 1 = Creative Mobile Technologies, 2 = Curb Mobility, 6 = Myle Technologies, 7 = Helix.
tpep_pickup_datetime: Date and time the meter was engaged.
tpep_dropoff_datetime: Date and time the meter was disengaged.
passenger_count: Number of passengers (entered by the driver).
trip_distance: Elapsed trip distance in miles reported by the taximeter.
RatecodeID: Final rate code: 1 = Standard, 2 = JFK, 3 = Newark, 4 = Nassau or Westchester, 5 = Negotiated fare, 6 = Group ride, 99 = Null/unknown.
store_and_fwd_flag: Y = trip record held in vehicle memory before sending (no server connection), N = not a store-and-forward trip.
PULocationID: TLC taxi zone where the meter was engaged.
DOLocationID: TLC taxi zone where the meter was disengaged.
payment_type: How the passenger paid: 0 = Flex Fare trip, 1 = Credit card, 2 = Cash, 3 = No charge, 4 = Dispute, 5 = Unknown, 6 = Voided trip.
fare_amount: Time-and-distance fare calculated by the meter (USD).
mta_tax: MTA tax triggered by the metered rate (USD).
tip_amount: Tip (USD). Populated automatically for credit card tips; CASH TIPS ARE NOT RECORDED, so cash trips show 0 tip regardless of what was paid.
improvement_surcharge: Improvement surcharge assessed at flag drop (USD).
total_amount: Total amount charged to passengers, excluding cash tips (USD).
Airport_fee: Fee for pick up at LaGuardia and JFK airports (USD).
_notes: Negative amounts usually mark refunds or voided/disputed trips. Source: NYC TLC Yellow Taxi data dictionary.
